correctness.rationale: The iid-increment construction follows from exact conditional rotational invariance of N(0,I_2), plus almost-sure invertibility. Polar integration gives an exact logarithmic expectation; a monotone derivative ratio proves unique minimizer and one positive zero. Signs are bracketed analytically and by explicit monotone integral bounds. Gaussian fourth moments prove the contrasting sharp second-moment threshold, and the centered iid LIL establishes critical oscillation. Actual included check.py reproduces integrals, roots, and trajectories; none of these finite checks is used to claim an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The 2026 residual-tracking paper prescribes a step through the squared-error contraction polynomial. The new complete planar pathwise classification distinguishes its prediction for typical deterministic trajectories from that second-moment condition, quantifies a nontrivial 0.5 to 0.937 convergence window, proves a unique rate-optimal gain distinct from the source moment-optimal gain, and resolves critical behavior. This guides exact interpretation of stochastic sketch stability while expressly not replacing moment bounds for full noisy optimization.
